responsibility: Provides the main target configuration header for the PDP-11 port, defining the machine model seen by GCC’s generic middle and back ends. It fixes data-layout properties such as word size, endianness, alignments, type sizes, pointer mode, floating formats, register names and fixed/call-used sets, condition-code handling macros, assembler syntax macros, section directives, symbol naming rules, trampoline size, library/runtime capability overrides, and target preprocessor builtins, thereby establishing the static ABI, register, and assembler conventions that the rest of the backend follows.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the declarative target header for the PDP-11 port, defining compile-time macros, machine properties, register names/sets, ABI layout, and assembler-format macros. Unlike pdp11.cc, it does not implement target hooks; unlike pdp11.md, it does not encode instruction-recognition/output patterns; and unlike pdp11.opt, it does not define user-visible options, but instead supplies the static configuration those other files use.
